title: MCPyV Co-Immunoprecipitation Protocol
author: Kristine Dye
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v6ke9cw

steps.title: Cell Seeding
steps.instruction: Seed a 10cm plate with enough cells to reach approximately 80% confluence by the following afternoon.

steps.title: Cell Transfection
steps.instruction: Transfect the cells using the preferred transfection reagent and protocol.

steps.title: Cell Harvest and Lysis
steps.instruction: Harvest cells 36-48 hours post-transfection and prepare lysates on ice.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells with cold PBS.
Scrape cells into 10mL cold PBS and transfer to a 10mL conical tube.
Centrifuge tubes at 300g, 4°C, for 5 min.
Suction off PBS while working on ice.
Resuspend cellular pellets in 533uL of Buffer A.
Add 33uL of 10% NP40 and pipette well (do not vortex).
Incubate tubes on ice for 5 minutes.
Sonicate samples on ice at 20% amplitude for 8 seconds (1 second pulse on, 1 second pulse off).
Rotate lysates in the cold room for 1 hour.
Centrifuge lysates at 14000rpm, 4°C, for 15min.
Transfer cleared lysates to prechilled Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Protein Concentration Determination
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration and prepare input samples.

substeps.instruction: Perform BCA assay (or preferred method) to determine protein concentration.
Add 30ug of cleared cellular lysate to SDS sample buffer.
Boil at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Cool samples on ice and centrifuge.
Either store at -20°C or run 30ug of each sample in an 8-16% Tris-Glycine gel at 150V for 50 minutes.

steps.title: Bead Preparation (IP Day 1)
steps.instruction: Prepare and wash A/G magnetic beads for blocking and pre-clearing.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2 tubes per sample, each containing 25uL of A/G magnetic beads and 500uL of cold PBS.
Place tubes in a magnetic rack and remove PBS.
Add 500uL of PBS to each tube, resuspend, and remove PBS using a magnetic rack.
Add 500uL of KCl buffer to each tube, resuspend, and remove KCl buffer using a magnetic rack.

steps.title: Bead Blocking and Lysate Pre-clearing (IP Day 1)
steps.instruction: Split the prepared beads into two sets: one for blocking and one for pre-clearing lysates.

substeps.instruction: For the first set of tubes: add 500uL of 1% BSA and rotate in the cold room overnight.
For the second set of tubes: add 500ug of lysate to the 25uL of washed beads.
Add Buffer A to the pre-clear tubes until the final volume reaches ~500uL.
Rotate in the cold room for 1 hour (remaining lysate may be kept at -80°C).
Perform a short spin on pre-cleared lysates, place in a magnetic rack, transfer lysates to a clean tube, and discard beads.

steps.title: Antibody Incubation (IP Day 1)
steps.instruction: Incubate pre-cleared lysates with the target antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add 10ug of the immunoprecipitation antibody to the pre-cleared lysates.
Rotate in the cold room overnight.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation (IP Day 2)
steps.instruction: Capture the antibody-protein complexes using the blocked beads.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve blocked beads and lysate/antibody samples from the cold room.
Remove BSA from the beads using a magnetic rack.
Perform a short spin and add the lysate/antibody samples to the beads.
Rotate for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Elution and Analysis (IP Day 2)
steps.instruction: Wash the beads and prepare the samples for SDS-PAGE.

substeps.instruction: Perform a short spin and remove the lysate from the beads.
Wash the beads several times with KCl buffer.
Remove the final KCl buffer and resuspend beads in 30uL of 2X SDS sample buffer.
Boil at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Store samples at -20°C or run immediately in an 8-16% Tris-Glycine gel at 150V for 50 minutes.
Transfer gel to an Immobilon-P membrane, then block, immunoblot, and develop with desired antibodies.
